digest.component_or_area: partial-clone test fixtures and worker parallelization
propositions: Partial-clone test fixtures create >100MiB objects duplicated per xdist worker, consuming ~32.69 aggregate worker-phase seconds.
The large-object guard cannot be replaced by mocks or config inspection; it must use real Git protocol and demonstrate filter:blob:none negotiation with a known missing blob.

Tests can be partitioned into size-independent cases (filter negotiation, missing-object, identity, reconvergence, push) suitable for small ephemeral fixtures and size-dependent cases requiring the large guard.
Isolated ephemeral protocol fixtures with explicit per-worker teardown prevent race conditions and cross-worker contamination without sharing mutable state.
Splitting fixtures into one retained large guard and isolated small real-protocol servers achieves ~70% pytest wall-time and ~85% setup-time savings.
